nodes.description: Ownership address storage slot; set from tx.origin in constructor and used as the sole privilege check for delegate() and list().
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract called by the checkBots modifier.
Uniswap pair address computed in constructor and passed into the bot-protection call.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated directly by transferFrom and list().
Public nested mapping of allowances, decremented in transferFrom and fully overwritten in approve().
Total token supply constant-state used inside list() to derive the owner allocation.
Hardcoded UniswapV2Router02 instance used to add liquidity in list().
Hardcoded WBNB address used for pair derivation and liquidity deployment.
Token decimals constant (18).
Token name string 'Cryptomeda'.
Token symbol string 'TECH'.
TechToken constructor: assigns owner from tx.origin, derives uniPair and grants infinite allowances.
Modifier that performs an external HTTP-like call to the bot-protection contract and requires it to return true.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the checkBots modifier; mutates allowances and balances with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that overwrites the caller's allowance entry.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address and calldata.
Internal pure helper that derives the deterministic Uniswap pair address from two tokens.
Owner-only listing function that rewrites balances, invokes the router to add liquidity and mass-distributes tokens to an address array.
Caller-controlled address used in allowance checks, balance writes and privilege checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute the router deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Origin account used in the constructor to set owner and to seed infinite allowances.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) executed with the contract's own storage and balance.
Low-level call into protectionFromBots where the success boolean is required but the returned bytes and reentrancy surface are unchecked.
External payable call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH that forwards msg.value and executes third-party code.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value arithmetic performed without SafeMath.
Raw allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value arithmetic performed without SafeMath.
Constructor parameter storing the external bot-protection contract address.
Recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate().
Raw calldata bytes parameter of delegate().
Amount parameter of list() used both as balance and liquidity token amount.
Array of recipient addresses in list().
Array of amounts assigned to _tos in list().
First token address passed to pairForUniswap.
Second token address passed to pairForUniswap.
Loop index over _tos/_amounts inside list().
Lower-sorted token address computed in pairForUniswap.
Higher-sorted token address computed in pairForUniswap.
Pair address derived from the CREATE2 keccak hash inside pairForUniswap.
Success boolean returned by the bot-protection external call in checkBots.
Returned bytes payload of the bot-protection external call in checkBots.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is consumed to initialize contract state.
_botProtection is written into the protectionFromBots state variable.
tx.origin is read inside the constructor to set the privileged owner account.
owner is assigned directly from the attacker-influenced tx.origin value.
Infinite allowance for the pair is granted to tx.origin in the constructor.
Constructor calls pairForUniswap to derive the pair address.
Constructor stores the pair returned by pairForUniswap into uniPair.
Constructor grants infinite allowance to the router state variable.
Constructor reads wBNB to compute the pair address.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument.
transfer forwards the _to parameter.
transfer forwards the _value parameter.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier.
checkBots reads the protectionFromBots address for the external call.
checkBots passes uniPair into the bot-protection selector arguments.
Modifier performs an external low-level call before the guarded function body executes.
External call target is the protectionFromBots state variable.
checkBots stores the call success flag into the notABot local.
checkBots stores the returned bytes into the isNotBot local.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for the allowance spender check.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping during the transferFrom allowance check.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom consumes the _from parameter.
_from indexes balanceOf for debit and credit operations.
_from indexes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom consumes the _to recipient parameter.
transferFrom consumes the _value amount parameter.
transferFrom executes raw unchecked allowance subtraction.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom executes raw unchecked balance subtraction.
_value flows into the unchecked balance subtraction.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve consumes the _spender parameter.
approve consumes the _value amount parameter.
delegate gates execution on equality with the owner state variable.
delegate compares msg.sender against owner for authorization.
Owner-restricted function executes an arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-supplied calldata.
The a parameter becomes the delegatecall target address.
The b parameter becomes the delegatecall calldata.
pairForUniswap consumes tokenA.
pairForUniswap consumes tokenB.
tokenA may be selected as token0 by the sort comparison.
tokenB may be selected as token0 by the sort comparison.
tokenA may be selected as token1 by the sort comparison.
tokenB may be selected as token1 by the sort comparison.
pairForUniswap assigns the computed hash into the pair local.
token0 feeds the keccak pair-address derivation.
token1 feeds the keccak pair-address derivation.
list is gated on the caller being the owner state variable.
list compares msg.sender to owner for authorization and uses it as balance key.
list consumes the _numList amount parameter.
list consumes the _tos recipient array.
list consumes the _amounts array.
list directly overwrites balanceOf entries for the contract and recipients.
Elements of _tos index balanceOf writes inside the loop.
Elements of _amounts are written into balanceOf inside the loop.
list computes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100 from the supply state variable.
list performs an external payable router call before distributing balances.
addLiquidityETH is invoked on the uniRouter state variable.
The router liquidity call interacts with the WBNB token address.
The router deadline is derived from block.timestamp, making execution miner-influenceable.
list reads block.timestamp to build the addLiquidityETH deadline.
list performs a second unchecked external call (selector 0xd5eaf4c3) before finishing state updates.
list declares and drives the loop index i.
The length of _tos bounds the loop index.
_amounts is indexed by the loop counter i.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only initializes protectionFromBots and has no independent behavior.
Recipient parameter is only consumed inside the transferFrom state updates.
Amount parameter flows directly into the unchecked balance and allowance subtractions within transferFrom.
Source parameter is only used to index balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom.
Spender parameter only indexes the allowance mapping inside approve.
Target address parameter is the destination of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Calldata parameter is the payload of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Amount parameter is used both as a balance write and as the router liquidity amount in list.
Recipient array is iterated and written into balanceOf by list.
Amount array supplies the values assigned to each recipient in list.
Token parameter is only sorted and hashed inside pairForUniswap.
Token parameter is only sorted and hashed inside pairForUniswap.
Loop counter exists solely to drive the distribution loop in list.
Sorting intermediate feeding the keccak pair derivation in pairForUniswap.
Sorting intermediate feeding the keccak pair derivation in pairForUniswap.
Computed pair address is the return value of pairForUniswap.
Success flag is the direct result of the bot-protection external call in checkBots.
Returned bytes payload is unused output of the bot-protection external call in checkBots.
